name: Gyoukou no Lament
source:
It has been years since the discovery of the Haya infection, which causes a marked increase in violent behavior in those who contract it. 

Since you lost your mother two years ago, you have been hiding out in Kichijoji Town where your relatives live. One day, the town is attacked by a large number of infected people, and Kichijoji Town is destroyed. A mysterious young man named Noel appears to shelter you. Haruaki, a doctor dispatched by the government to protect the survivors. You have to decide which one to entrust your life to.......

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.lamentglobal]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
哈亚感染被发现已经有很多年了，这种感染导致感染者的暴力行为显着增加。

自从两年前失去母亲以来，你一直躲藏在亲戚居住的吉祥寺町。某一天，小镇遭到大量感染者的袭击，吉祥寺町被毁。一个名叫诺埃尔的神秘年轻人出现庇护你。政府派去保护幸存者的医生晴明。你必须决定把你的生命托付给谁……

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.lamentglobal]Google Play[/url]]
